title: Stage transport of a restriction tensor representative
statement: In the raw rational finite coefficient stages, fix a scheme morphism f:Y→X with the coefficient prime invertible in residue fields. For a family of stagewise pullback/tensor isomorphisms mu satisfying the mixed tensor scalar square, form the endpoint comparison conjugate c_K at each common coefficient stage K for a pair of input representatives A,B. For every enlargement h:H≤L from the compositum stage H, c_L is the stage-system transport of c_H. The equality retains the transition isomorphisms and does not identify distinct coefficient fields literally.

source.place: Final invertibility assertion; fixed-component enlargement calculation of steps 3–5.

proof.text: At the compositum H, define d to be mu_H on A and B transported to H, followed by the tensor image of the inverses of the two pullback endpoint comparisons at H. This is a morphism between the literal objects underlying the two output pairs.

Use the transition equality in stageSystem_existsUnique to conjugate the assumed scalar mixed square into a square for rationalPullbackStageComparison and rationalTensorStageComparison. Substitution of the transition equalities proves that this retains the prescribed square.

Expand the two common-stage endpoint comparisons into the normalized stage comparisons and the two input associators. Apply rationalPullbackStageComparison_coherent separately to A.stage <= H <= K and B.stage <= H <= K; these equations identify the two enlarged pullback endpoints.

Naturality of the tensor scalar comparison moves the inverse pullback endpoints through scalar extension. The two pullback coherence equations cancel these inverses. Apply the assumed mixed square at H <= K, and then naturality of mu_K along the input associators. Cancel the invertible target endpoint to obtain c_K = T_{K/H}(d). The proved mixedTensorStageComponent theorem supplies this categorical calculation and its input coherence equations.

Apply the preceding formula at K=L and K=H, including the reflexive transition at H. StageSystem.tr_map says that transport of T_{H/H}(d) is T_{L/H}(d), proving the asserted equality without any identity identification of distinct coefficient fields.

proof_origin.place: Common-stage enlargement calculation: mixed scalar square, pullback endpoint coherence and stage transport of an actual morphism.

lean.statement:
theorem restrictionTensorRepresentativeStageTransport
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω]
    [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)] :
    let R := fun E : Index l Ω ↦ rationalDerivedPullback l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) f
    let T := fun (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      (E : Index l Ω) ↦ rationalDerivedTensor l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W
    let b := fun (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) ↦
      rationalPullbackScalarComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
        (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) f
    let theta := fun (W : Scheme.{u}) [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)]
      (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) ↦
      rationalTensorScalarComparison l (Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
        (Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) (coefficientInclusion l Ω E L h) W
    let S := fun A B : Pair l Ω X ↦
      commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f (commonStageTensorObject l Ω X A B)
    let U := fun A B : Pair l Ω X ↦ commonStageTensorObject l Ω Y
      (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f A) (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f B)
    let a := fun (A B : Pair l Ω X) (L : Index l Ω) (h : (S A B).stage ≤ L) ↦
      commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f (commonStageTensorObject l Ω X A B) L h ≪≫
        (R L).mapIso (commonStageTensorComparison l Ω X A B L h)
    let z := fun (A B : Pair l Ω X) (L : Index l Ω) (h : (U A B).stage ≤ L) ↦
      commonStageTensorComparison l Ω Y
        (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f A) (commonStagePullbackObject l Ω f B) L h ≪≫
      (T Y L).mapIso (Iso.prod
        (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f A L
          (((Padic.finiteCoefficientFields_properties l Ω).1 A.stage B.stage).1.trans h))
        (commonStagePullbackComparison l Ω f B L
          (((Padic.finiteCoefficientFields_properties l Ω).1 A.stage B.stage).2.trans h)))
    ∀ (mu : ∀ E : Index l Ω, T X E ⋙ R E ≅ (R E).prod (R E) ⋙ T Y E),
      (∀ (E L : Index l Ω) (h : E ≤ L) (M N : Stage l Ω X E),
        (transition l Ω Y E L h).map ((mu E).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
          (theta Y E L h).hom.app ((R E).obj M, (R E).obj N) ≫
          (T Y L).map (Prod.mkHom ((b E L h).hom.app M) ((b E L h).hom.app N)) =
        (b E L h).hom.app ((T X E).obj (M, N)) ≫
          (R L).map ((theta X E L h).hom.app (M, N)) ≫
          (mu L).hom.app ((transition l Ω X E L h).obj M,
            (transition l Ω X E L h).obj N)) →
      ∀ (A B : Pair l Ω X) (L : Index l Ω) (h : (S A B).stage ≤ L),
        let H := (S A B).stage
        let c := fun (K : Index l Ω) (hK : H ≤ K) ↦
          (a A B K hK).hom ≫
            (mu K).hom.app
              (A.toStage (((Padic.finiteCoefficientFields_properties l Ω).1
                A.stage B.stage).1.trans hK),
               B.toStage (((Padic.finiteCoefficientFields_properties l Ω).1
                A.stage B.stage).2.trans hK)) ≫ (z A B K hK).inv
        c L h = (stageSystem l Ω Y).tr h (c H le_rfl)
